To calculate the total, I need to know the quantities and prices of the items currently in the order. From our previous conversation, I noted that Line item 415 (Cable reels) and Line item 95 (Ladders) were key items to add, and that an adjustment was made to deduct 70 units for returned stock.

However, I do not have the specific unit counts or prices for these items in my memory. Could you please provide the details for the Cable reels and Ladders (quantity and price per unit)? Once you provide those, I can add up the order's lines step by step and give you the total.
